steps.path: An assistant reply that continues after compaction
steps.headline: New text stays below the compaction divider.
steps.changed: The divider stays at the break inside the reply instead of following the reply as it grows.
steps.notice: You can open the summary and continue reading below it. Running tools and the reply's accounting stay intact.
steps.risk: Messages above the divider remain readable; only messages actually summarized are faded.

steps.path: A compaction divider with a long freed-token label
steps.headline: The summary action stays visible on a phone.
steps.changed: A long divider wraps instead of clipping the summary button beyond the chat edge.
steps.notice: View summary stays reachable at phone width, with the same expandable summary as desktop.
steps.risk: The divider can take two lines on a narrow screen.
